follow-up time: Through the perinatal period (duration of pregnancy)
exposure: Indication for surgery (fulminant/refractory colitis vs. bowel obstruction)
Indication for cesarean section (physician's preference, planned small bowel surgery, metabolic disorders)
cohort: Nine pregnant women who underwent surgery for abdominal complications of ulcerative colitis.
finding: Surgery for ulcerative colitis complications during pregnancy can be performed safely with a multidisciplinary team approach.
mod_finding: Of the nine patients, two had vaginal deliveries and seven had cesarean sections.
